items.distractor_fact: એ જ સાંજે એક હવામાન એપ પર દેખાતું તાપમાન {D}°C હતું.
items.gloss_en: That same evening, the temperature shown on a weather app was {D} °C.
items.entity_note: a weather app reading (an instrument), a different kind of owner than the first sentence's neighboring city (a place).

items.distractor_fact: એ જ દિવસે એક ખાનગી રોકાણકારે ધરાવેલ એક અલગ કંપનીના શેરનો ભાવ €{D} હતો.
items.gloss_en: That same day, the share price of a different company held by a private investor was €{D}.
items.entity_note: a private investor's holding in a different company (a person), a different kind of owner than the first sentence's rival company (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: એ જ સમયે એક કંપની દ્વારા સંચાલિત જળાશયનું પાણીનું સ્તર {D} m હતું.
items.gloss_en: At the same time, the water level of a reservoir operated by a company was {D} m.
items.entity_note: a reservoir run by a company (an organisation), a different kind of owner than the first sentence's neighboring lake (a place).

items.distractor_fact: એક પડોશીના બચત ખાતામાં આ મહિને €{D} જમા થયા.
items.gloss_en: A neighbor's savings account had €{D} deposited into it this month.
items.entity_note: a neighbor's account (a person), a different kind of owner than the first sentence's another unspecified savings account (an instrument).

items.distractor_fact: એક મિત્રના ગિફ્ટ કાર્ડમાં શરૂઆતમાં €{D} હતા.
items.gloss_en: A friend's gift card had €{D} on it at the start.
items.entity_note: a friend's gift card (a person), a different kind of owner than the first sentence's another unspecified gift card (an instrument).

items.distractor_fact: એક કુટુંબના સભ્યના મોબાઇલ ડેટા પ્લાનમાં મહિનાની શરૂઆતમાં {D} GB હતું.
items.gloss_en: A family member's mobile data plan had {D} GB at the start of the month.
items.entity_note: a family member's plan (a person), a different kind of owner than the first sentence's another unspecified data plan (an instrument).

items.distractor_fact: એક સ્થાનિક સખાવતી સંસ્થાની આ મહિનાની આવક €{D} હતી.
items.gloss_en: A local charity's income for the month was €{D}.
items.entity_note: a charity organisation (an organisation), a different kind of owner than the first sentence's neighboring household (a family/person group).

items.distractor_fact: આ ટીમના એક ખેલાડીએ પોતાની કારકિર્દીમાં કુલ {D} ગોલ કર્યા.
items.gloss_en: A player on this team scored a total of {D} goals over his career.
items.entity_note: an individual player (a person), a different kind of owner than the first sentence's another team in the same league (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: એક ફ્રીલાન્સ સલાહકારે એ જ ત્રિમાસિકમાં €{D} નફો નોંધાવ્યો.
items.gloss_en: A freelance consultant recorded €{D} in profit that same quarter.
items.entity_note: an individual freelance consultant (a person), a different kind of owner than the first sentence's another small business (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: એ જ સમયે એક ફ્લાઈટનું આગમન સમય રીડિંગ {D} min નોંધાયું, જેનું પોતાનું નિર્ધારિત સમયપત્રક અહીં આપેલું નથી.
items.gloss_en: At the same time, a flight's arrival time reading of {D} min was recorded, its own scheduled time not given here.
